_why: The video lab notebook (social/DAILY.md, 'The daily mix'). Each day runs two experiments, each changing ONE thing from the countdown format. 'backlog' is what to try, best bets first; 'results' records each run, scored 72 hours after posting: 1,000+ views and 9+ s watch = promote, under 500 = drop, between = retry once with one tweak.

baseline.note: Famous-name groupings did best: UC 17,933 (241 shares), Penn 5,169, Ivy 3,888. Plain state groupings in week 2 ran 600-2,500.

backlog.idea: Part 2 of the UC video (17.9K views): the same 9 UC campuses ranked by a different number, e.g. Asian restaurants nearby or the busiest food street. Open with 'You asked for part 2.'
backlog.why: TikTok pushes follow-ups to viewers of a hit.

backlog.idea: Head-to-head: Alabama vs Auburn (27 vs 21, close), USC vs UCLA (94 vs 14), Michigan vs Ohio State (224 vs 86). Split-screen maps, counts climb together, winner at the end.
backlog.why: Rivalry comments and shares; tests whether a close race holds people longer than a list.

backlog.changes: school name hidden until the end
backlog.idea: 'Guess the campus': the map with no name while the count climbs, three multiple-choice options on screen, reveal at the end.
backlog.why: Withholding the answer should raise watch time and comments.

backlog.changes: grouping chosen for fame, not geography
backlog.idea: Stanford vs Harvard vs MIT vs Princeton vs Yale and other household names, ranked by restaurants within a 10-minute walk.
backlog.why: Every famous-name video beat the plain state ones.

backlog.changes: a city's colleges instead of a state's
backlog.idea: Every college in one city: Boston, New York, Chicago, LA. Check each campus map first (Boston University's count looked low).
The same countdown cut to the top 3.
backlog.why: Tests whether completion rate beats total watch time. Caution (Nov 11): inside competitor accounts, videos shorter than usual got about half the views; only a single-fact reveal looks promising short.

backlog.changes: one surprising national number, no schools
backlog.idea: e.g. 'Pizza places outnumber salad places 20 to 1 near US campuses' (from the campus data).
backlog.why: Tests a broad hook against a school hook.

backlog.idea: Reply to a comment on a hit ('Where's my school?'). Needs the owner to read the comments and pass one on.
backlog.why: Comment replies are a strong TikTok growth signal.

backlog.changes: a spoken voiceover with one-word captions, the map moving from frame 0
backlog.idea: Open with a short spoken question (10 words or fewer) captioned one word at a time, the map already zooming in, and the first entry by ~3 s. A text-to-speech voice in the pipeline (owner's OK needed), or the owner records it.
backlog.why: Every video of both competitor map countdowns (4K-25K typical views on ~16K followers) talks and moves from the first frame; ours is silent and static for 4-6 s.
backlog.status: running on every video from Nov 12; judge on views, watch time and shares vs. the silent baseline after 4+ videos

backlog.changes: the list has a named loser and an open question
backlog.idea: Rank a state's or conference's campuses from food desert to food heaven (fewest to most restaurants within a 10-minute walk), name the food desert, end with 'Did your school make it? Is it fair?'. About food access, never about the students.
backlog.why: The competitor state college countdown gets 12-30 shares per 1,000 views with a provocative frame; our state lists get ~3.

backlog.idea: A full countdown of 12-15 schools for a big state or conference, inside the 60 s cap.
backlog.why: In all 6 measured competitor accounts the hits ran longer than the flops (63 vs 56 s); their hits sit at 55-70 s; ours at 35 s.

backlog.changes: a real photo of each campus next to its number
backlog.idea: Licensed campus photos (Wikimedia Commons, credited) beside the map at each entry.
backlog.why: Every entry in the competitor map countdowns shows a photo of the place.

backlog.changes: 15 s, one ranking fact, answer on screen within 1 s
backlog.idea: One striking result from the campus data, e.g. the campus with the most restaurants within a 10-minute walk in the country, shown instantly.
backlog.why: An admissions account's 6-8 s single-ranking posts got ~380K-390K views vs 500-5K for its other videos.

results.what: countdown: Houston colleges with 5,000+ students by w (#1 UH-Downtown 114, tease Rice (4th))
results.note: Tease changed by hand from UH (2nd) to Rice (4th): clearer to non-locals and better known; school names spelled out (University of Houston, UH-Downtown, UH-Clear Lake).

results.what: countdown: 20 famous American universities by w (#1 NYU 1462, tease Harvard (7th))
every video read aloud from frame 0 (Kokoro voice), the hook map pushing in, first entry at ~4.5 s instead of 5.7 s, last place called out, #1's margin spoken
results.baseline: silent countdowns, last 7 days: median 1,183 views, 14 of 24 at 1,000+
